description: Find grants, subsidies and public funding in Spain (ayudas y subvenciones de España). Search BDNS by topic and compare published beneficiaries, deadlines and official links.

defaultPrompt: Busca ayudas de digitalización en España y compara los plazos y beneficiarios publicados.
Find grants in Spain for research projects and link the official calls.
Busca subvenciones para autónomos en BDNS y explica qué requisitos debo comprobar.
interface.longDescription: Find public funding opportunities in Spain (España) for your business, association or research project. Search BDNS by topic and compare the returned calls, published beneficiary categories, dates and original links in one sourced answer. Review up to five records per page and continue when useful. Check the current call and its rules before applying: a listed record can be historical or a direct award. The connector searches public records; it does not submit applications or guarantee funding.
